title: commissioning.<sessionId>.progress
description:
Progress of an in-flight `commission` call or config flow.

Commissioning takes tens of seconds and passes through stages the user can act on — "press the button", "joining network". Without this the UI shows an indeterminate spinner and the user cannot tell a slow pairing from a hung one.

progress.title: Fraction complete
progress.description: 0..1. Absent when the plugin cannot estimate, which is honest and better than a fabricated number.

deviceRef.description: Available only once the device has an identity — not on early stages.
